warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 4.00 + 4.00 (8.00); y = A-B-C-D at 4.00 + 3.50 + 1.00 (8.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04, A-03, A-04 and the elevations/sections. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page.

Plan dummies from S-01/S-02 (repeated on A-03 and A-09): x 2' (5.80, chain 1.80 + 2.20) and 3' (8.50, 0.50 past grid 3); y A'' (2.50, chain 2.50 + 1.50) and B' (6.00, chain 2.00 + 1.50). Each carries a beam on S-02 (B1 on 2' and 3', B3 on A'', B2 on B'), none has a column or footing.

Roof dummies from S-03/S-04: x 1'' (2.00, chain 2.00 + 2.00 between 1 and 2 = line of truss T3) and y A''' (3.75, chain 3.75 + 0.25 between A and B = line of truss T2, the ridge). Eaves from S-04 and A-04: 1.00 past grids 1, 3, A and D -> 1' (-1.00), 3'' (9.00), A' (-1.00), D' (9.50).
Before-origin dummies share the first main grid's prime sequence: x 1' (-1.00) then 1'' (2.00); y A' (-1.00), A'' (2.50), A''' (3.75).

The three truss elevations (T1, T3 on S-03; T2 on S-04) print their panel chains with no grid markers under them, so they are recorded as floating chains with 'edge' ends and make no lines (section 4 rule 4). Read against the plans they fit exactly — T1 along grid 2 from D to A (1.00 = D-C, then 1.25 x 6 to A, apex at 3.75 = A'''), T3 along 1'' from D to A''' (1.00, 1.00, 0.92 x 3), T2 along A''' from 1 to 3 (2.00 x 4) — and the S-03 post markers sit on those panel points, but the panel points themselves are not grid lines.

z: ระดับถนน ±0.00 is the datum (A-05..A-08); ลานซักล้าง room tag +0.00 (A-03) is the same level and is not listed twice. Levels kept as printed; the detail row 0.64 + 3.45 + 1.15 + 1.01 adds to 6.25 against the printed 6.26 (drawing rounding). ระดับดินเดิม (S-05) and ระดับฝ้าเพดาน (A-07/A-08) print no value -> level_m null.

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-06 (S-05/S-06 print only member-internal sizes, kept on their elements) plus A-03 แปลนพื้น, A-04 แปลนหลังคา, A-05/A-06 รูปด้าน 1-4, A-07/A-08 รูปตัด A/B and A-09 แบบขยายห้องน้ำ. Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: A-01 (text only), A-10/A-11 door/window details (opening sizes stay on the schedule elements), E-01, SN-01, SN-02.
